designs.name: Meridian
designs.motif: An open oval in polished gold, interrupted by an emerald-cut green stone.
designs.construction: A softly squared elongated oval frame of substantial polished 18k yellow gold, intentionally open at its lower right. Neither a circle nor an infinity knot.

designs.name: Ribbon
designs.motif: One broad gold ribbon folds back on itself, ending in a line of diamonds.

It is not a bow, knot, letter, infinity symbol, or interlocking chain.

designs.name: Petal

No four-leaf clover outline, no milgrain border, no five-petal daisy, no copying another house motif.

assets.label: Shooting Star detail
assets.use: Americana and Shooting Star design pages
assets.alt: Yellow-gold Shooting Star ring with five graduated diamonds on forest-green silk
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a single extraordinary fine-jewelry macro editorial photograph for a designer-house website, landscape 3:2, highest available native resolution. The reference is the exact object to preserve: one slender polished yellow-gold ring with a solid five-point gold star and exactly five graduated round white diamonds forming an asymmetric tail. Show the entire star, all five stones, their delicate gold settings, and enough of the curved shank to understand the ring. Do not add stones, change the design, or turn it into a pendant. Compose the star and jeweled tail along a descending diagonal through the center of the frame; the ring occupies roughly 70 percent of the image width, with breathing room. The ring rests on finely textured deep forest-green silk, a darker quieter version of the reference leather, with one barely visible fold receding behind it. Close grazing daylight, luminous gold-edge reflections, physically convincing transparent stone facets with deep internal contrast; focus-stacked jewelry detail but softly receding fabric, real optical photography rather than illustration or plastic render. Refined color, no oversaturation, no blown white metal edges, no fake starbursts, no floating jewels, no colored gemstones, no text or watermark. This is an editorial close study of the same ring used in the hand campaign.

assets.label: Signal worn
assets.use: Bridal and Signal product gallery
assets.alt: Four-prong platinum Signal solitaire on a hand against blue-gray silk
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a fine-jewelry bridal editorial photograph, portrait 4:5, highest available native resolution. Use the reference image as the exact Signal solitaire design: polished platinum slim plain band, one round brilliant diamond held by EXACTLY FOUR prongs at diagonal corners, raised open basket, discreet small round bezel-set diamond below the center in the gallery. Preserve the ring, no halo, no pavé, no extra bands, no six-prong substitution. Scene: a natural adult woman's hand wearing this ring, relaxed fingers gently curved over the edge of a deep blue-gray silk sleeve. Crop from wrist to fingertips without face or body; immaculate short natural nails, warm human skin with pores and real fine creases. The ring sits in the middle upper third, prominent yet realistically about 8 mm center-stone diameter relative to the finger, with the four claws readable. Soft directional window light from the side and controlled dark reflection give platinum clean luminous edges, diamond true transparent faceting rather than white glitter. Composition is sculptural, calm, intimate, high-fashion jewelry editorial; muted midnight-blue fabric and cool gray backdrop balance natural skin. Ring and adjacent finger in pin-sharp focus, gentle optical falloff elsewhere. No flowers, wedding props, extra jewelry, logos, words, watermark, plastic skin, impossible fingers, exaggerated huge gem, fake sparkle, or CGI aesthetic.
